_about: GENERIC, SYNTHETIC requirement sets summarising the kind of skills these employers commonly advertise for early-career Software Engineer roles. They are NOT real job postings and are not copied from any posting. Used only to tailor sample resumes (ordering/emphasis of existing facts).

mnc.title: Software Engineer
mnc.description_text:
Generic MNC software engineer profile (synthetic).
Requirements
• Strong programming in C#/.NET or Python
• REST APIs and SQL databases
• Data structures, algorithms and system design fundamentals
• Git, code review and unit testing
Nice to have
• Cloud (AWS or Azure), Docker, CI/CD
• Experience with LLMs / generative AI

google.title: Software Engineer
google.description_text:
Generic Google-style SWE requirement set (synthetic, not a real posting).
Minimum qualifications
• Experience programming in one or more of Python, Java, C++ or Go
• Data structures and algorithms
• Software design and system design at scale
Preferred qualifications
• Distributed systems, large-scale systems
• Machine learning or LLMs / generative AI
• Unit testing and code review

amazon.title: Software Development Engineer
amazon.description_text:
Generic Amazon-style SDE requirement set (synthetic, not a real posting).
Basic qualifications
• Programming experience with Java, Python or C#
• Data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design
• Building REST APIs and services
Preferred qualifications
• AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), distributed systems
• SQL databases, CI/CD and unit testing
• Ownership of features end to end
